summary: American Resources Corp filed an 8-K on July 21, 2026, announcing a share repurchase program authorized by its Board on July 12, 2026. The program allows repurchases of up to $20.0 million of its Class A common stock through open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, block trades, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. Management will determine timing, price, and amount based on market conditions, capital availability, and other factors. The program does not obligate the company to repurchase any specific number of shares and may be suspended or terminated at any time. No advisor or recommendation was disclosed. Watch for actual repurchase activity and potential price support.
